message: Good morning. The clock has been reset: today is Day 1 of 150. The old numbering was fiction — it counted 29 days while the baseline sat unfilmed. That's gone. The arc now runs 3 September to 30 January, and it starts with what you do in the next few hours.

Day 1 has exactly one job: film the baseline. 100m timed twice, standing long jump, vertical, bodyweight on camera, and the straight-to-camera piece saying the target and the date out loud. This footage is unrepeatable — you only get one Day 1, and this time it's today. Recovery is 67%, sleep 76% — your body is ready to be tested.

Everything downstream is already re-anchored: the plan, the dashboard, and your Todoist list all say Day 1 now. The hamstring rule restarts with the clock — four weeks of ramp work, nothing maximal until 1 October. The two overdue bills (Fitness Passports $69, Car Insurance $58) are the only leftovers from before; clear them today so Day 1 starts clean.

One thing before you film: read the plan and tell me in the chat if the sub-12 target still stands. The number you say to camera today is the one you'll be chasing until 30 January — make sure it's the one you mean.

today.text: Film the Day 1 baseline tests — 100m ×2, long jump, vertical, bodyweight, and the stakes piece to camera
Write the Ep 1 hook — five versions out loud, keep the one that doesn't sound written

Clear the two overdue bills — Fitness Passports $69, Car Insurance $58 — pay or hand to Karin
Read the content plan and confirm the sub-12 target before you say it on camera
